policyName: Windows Firewall Rules - Domain profile - Hybrid joined devices
policyDescription: Inbound management exceptions for hybrid joined devices, modeled on the built-in Windows Firewall rule groups that are typically enabled by GPO. Domain profile only. Created with New-IntuneFirewallRulePolicy.ps1.

rules.name: Core Networking Diagnostics - ICMP Echo Request (ICMPv4-In)
rules.description: Ping (ICMPv4 echo request) for troubleshooting. Built-in group: Core Networking Diagnostics.

rules.name: Core Networking Diagnostics - ICMP Echo Request (ICMPv6-In)
rules.description: Ping (ICMPv6 echo request) for troubleshooting. Built-in group: Core Networking Diagnostics.

rules.name: File and Printer Sharing (SMB-In)
rules.description: SMB (TCP 445) for admin shares (C$, ADMIN$) and remote tools. Built-in group: File and Printer Sharing. Also covers the NP-In (named pipes) rules of Remote Event Log Management and Remote Service Management.

rules.name: Remote Desktop - User Mode (UDP-In)
rules.description: RDP UDP transport (UDP 3389). Built-in group: Remote Desktop.

rules.name: Windows Remote Management (HTTP-In)
rules.description: WinRM / PowerShell remoting (TCP 5985). Built-in group: Windows Remote Management.

rules.name: RPC Endpoint Mapper (TCP-In)
rules.description: RPC endpoint mapper (TCP 135, svchost.exe/RpcSs). Replaces the RPC-EPMAP and DCOM-In rules of the built-in groups WMI, Remote Event Log Management, Remote Service Management, Remote Scheduled Tasks Management and Windows Defender Firewall Remote Management. The port keyword RPC-EPMap is not accepted by the Firewall CSP.

rules.name: Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI-In)
rules.description: WMI / CIM over DCOM. Built-in group: Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI). Local port is any: scoped by service instead of the RPC keyword.

rules.name: Windows Management Instrumentation (ASync-In)
rules.description: Asynchronous WMI callbacks to unsecapp.exe. Built-in group: Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI).

rules.name: Remote Event Log Management (RPC)
rules.description: Remote Event Viewer. Built-in group: Remote Event Log Management. Local port is any: scoped by service instead of the RPC keyword.

rules.name: Remote Service Management (RPC)
rules.description: Remote services.msc / sc.exe. Built-in group: Remote Service Management. Local port is any: scoped by program instead of the RPC keyword.

rules.name: Remote Scheduled Tasks Management (RPC)
rules.description: Remote Task Scheduler. Built-in group: Remote Scheduled Tasks Management. Local port is any: scoped by service instead of the RPC keyword.

rules.name: Windows Defender Firewall Remote Management (RPC)
rules.description: Remote wf.msc / NetSecurity cmdlets. Built-in group: Windows Defender Firewall Remote Management. Local port is any: scoped by service instead of the RPC keyword.
